CHECK (COALESCE(
CASE source_kind
    WHEN 'direct'::text THEN ((authority ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['device_control'::text, 'credential'::text]))
    WHEN 'policy'::text THEN (((authority ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['policy'::text, 'agent_install'::text, 'software'::text, 'retirement'::text])) AND ((authority ->> 'tenant'::text) = (tenant_id)::text) AND ((authority ->> 'device'::text) = device) AND ((authority ->> 'version'::text) = (policy_version)::text) AND (((authority ->> 'kind'::text) <> 'software'::text) OR ((authority ->> 'operation'::text) = (id)::text)))
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END, false))
CHECK ((((source_kind = 'direct'::text) AND (policy_version IS NULL)) OR ((source_kind = 'policy'::text) AND (policy_version IS NOT NULL))))
